sentences.text:
MR HM PRACHCHHAK, ADVOCATE for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR BH PUNANI, ADDL.PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ================================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE J.B.PARDIWALA
Date : 13/10/2014  ORAL ORDER Heard Mr. Prachchhak, the learned advocate for the petitioner.

The learned advocate for the petitioner pointed out that the Appellate Authority as provided under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 is yet to be constituted and the petitioner is rendered remediless.
Considering the said fact, Rule. Ms. Hansa Punani, the learned APP waives notice of rule on behalf of the respondent-State.
Ad-interim relief in terms of para 13(B).
Liberty to apply for final hearing after the pleadings are over.

(J.B.PARDIWALA, J.) Mohandas S.D.P Industries Pvt Ltd. Thro' vs State Of Gujarat & 2 on 13 October, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184874876/
